description: This file implements JNI bindings for TensorFlow Lite's NNAPI delegate, providing native methods to create, query, and delete delegate instances. It handles constructing delegate options, including FlatBuffer serialization when necessary, and interacts directly with NNAPI support libraries in some configurations.

methods.name: JNIEXPORT jlong JNICALL Java_org_tensorflow_lite_nnapi_NnApiDelegateImpl_createDelegate(JNIEnv * env,jclass clazz,jint preference,jstring accelerator_name,jstring cache_dir,jstring model_token,jint max_delegated_partitions,jboolean override_disallow_cpu,jboolean disallow_cpu_value,jboolean allow_fp16,jlong nnapi_support_library_handle)
methods.description: Creates an NNAPI delegate instance based on provided parameters, either via a delegate plugin interface with FlatBuffer configuration or directly using StatefulNnApiDelegate with options.

methods.name: JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL Java_org_tensorflow_lite_nnapi_NnApiDelegateImpl_getNnapiErrno(JNIEnv * env,jclass clazz,jlong delegate)
methods.description: Retrieves the latest error number from the NNAPI delegate instance.

methods.name: JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_org_tensorflow_lite_nnapi_NnApiDelegateImpl_deleteDelegate(JNIEnv * env,jclass clazz,jlong delegate)
methods.description: Deletes the NNAPI delegate instance to free resources.
